metadata.agent_last_message:
The implementation is complete. Here's what was built:

**`output/main.js`** — CLI entry point. Parses flags (`--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`/`--aux`, `--output`, `--log`), runs the pipeline, writes BBL on success or error JSON on failure, and emits the structured log.

**`output/bib.js`** — `.bib` parser. Handles `@string`, `@preamble`, `@comment`, regular entries with `{...}` or `(...)` delimiters, `#`-concatenated values with macro expansion, predefined month macros, duplicate-key detection, and field whitespace normalization.

**`output/bst.js`** — `.bst` lexer/parser. Tokenizes per `bibtex.web`'s `scan_fn_def` rules — function-name tokens run to whitespace/`}`/`%` (so `:=`, `=`, `>`, `<` etc. parse as identifiers).

**`output/runtime.js`** — Stack interpreter with all 37 built-ins, entry-scope/global symbol tables, sort-by-`sort.key$`, and crossref inheritance. Includes `change.case$` (title-mode preserves `ex_buf_ptr=0` and post-`: ` letters), `purify$` (with the 13 recognized accent control sequences), `text.length$`, `text.prefix$`, `width$` (using the cmr10 table from `bibtex.web` §13), and `substring$` (1-based, negative-from-end).

**`output/names.js`** — Author name parsing (Form 1/2/3 by comma count, with the lowercase-token rule that descends into `{\…}` specials) and `format.name$` implementing the §10270 inter-token-separator rule (sep_char preserved; tie if accumulated text < 3 chars or last gap; else space) plus discretionary trailing tie.

**`output/outbuf.js`** — Output buffer with 79-column wrapping per `bibtex.web` §15: backward-scan break in cols [3,79]; forward-scan fallback consuming the entire whitespace run; 2-space continuation indent; rtrim on emit.

**`output/widths.js`** — cmr10 character-width table.
